highlights.reason_zh: API 外观不变，但 provider、计费和数据路径改变，现有配置可能失效。
highlights.reason_en: The API looks familiar, but provider, billing and data paths change and existing configurations may break.

highlights.reason_zh: 容量和恢复能力增强，同时带来明确的延迟与兼容风险。
highlights.reason_en: Capacity and recovery improve while introducing explicit latency and compatibility risk.

highlights.reason_zh: 直接影响 coding agent 成本，但兼容性与发布方评测需要本地验证。
highlights.reason_en: It directly targets coding-agent cost, but compatibility and publisher-run results need local validation.

highlights.reason_zh: 从受限发布走向多国机构场景，扩大了真实采用证据。
highlights.reason_en: The restricted launch now has multinational field-use evidence.

highlights.reason_zh: 揭示科研 agent 在工具错误时仍会过度自信，并提供公开复跑材料。
highlights.reason_en: It exposes agent overconfidence under broken tools and provides public rerun artifacts.

coverage_zh: 固定入口 35/36 成功；Microsoft Research 可选入口超时后由官方博客恢复。覆盖模型、工具、开源、研究、基础设施、政策与重大综合新闻；两条文章只有日期精度，ENISA/CERT-EU PDF 无法直接抓取。
coverage_en: Fixed monitors succeeded for 35/36 sources; the optional Microsoft Research timeout was recovered through the official blog. Coverage included models, tools, open source, research, infrastructure, policy and exceptional general news; two posts had date-only precision and the ENISA/CERT-EU PDF was not directly retrievable.
